resources.string: Attempted to %1$s. Check the actual screen; a returned system call does not confirm completion.

Check whether the original action completed. If it did not, complete it yourself, then tap Continue. DSH will not send the original request again.

The later screen read did not confirm the planned handler in the foreground; the action will not be repeated.
